question.text: Which of the following statements about the NISM Series XV (Research Analyst) certification is CORRECT?

answer.text: It is optional for persons engaged as research analysts under SEBI regulations
It is required for associated persons registered under SEBI (Research Analyst) Regulations, 2014
It is only required for sell-side analysts, not buy-side analysts
It is awarded only on the basis of work experience, with no examination requirement

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that an associated person shall be required to pass the NISM-Series-XV: Research Analyst Certification Examination in order to fulfil the requirements specified under Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014. The Trap: Option A is incorrect because the certification is regulatory and mandatory for associated persons, not optional. Option C is wrong because the requirement applies to associated persons under the Research Analyst Regulations and is not limited to sell-side analysts. Option D is wrong because Series XV is an examination-based certification, not an experience-only credential. Note: Any further claims about validity period, Continuing Professional Education (CPE) renewal, or specific consequences of a lapsed certification should only be stated when a direct, current SEBI/NISM source is cited.
